affected_system: housing-stability, eviction prevention, shelter diversion, and support coordination
alternatives: screen feasible locations against the largest access gaps for low-barrier housing-stability service hubs
co-optimize distributed and high-capacity locations for low-barrier housing-stability service hubs
pair need-, transit-, language-, privacy-, and capacity-aware hub siting with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Court, assistance, shelter, outreach, housing, and service records use privacy-preserving linkage.
Risk models support outreach only and never determine legal rights or automatic denial.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: retain only existing approved locations for low-barrier housing-stability service hubs.

constraints.description: The homelessness prevention and housing stability site must respect declared land control, accessibility, permitting, safety, and operating feasibility.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: homelessness response director and housing-stability administrator
decision_question: Where should legal, benefits, diversion, document, and housing-navigation services be co-located?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The homelessness prevention and housing stability site must respect declared land control, accessibility, permitting, safety, and operating feasibility.
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for low-barrier housing-stability service hubs passes documented checks for parcel control, legal authority, environmental review, access, capacity, and operator responsibility.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: need-, transit-, language-, privacy-, and capacity-aware hub siting
independence_key.primary_outcome: eligible households beyond timely prevention access

intended_claim: A versioned site design for comparing declared alternatives affecting low-barrier housing-stability service hubs, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: eligible households beyond timely prevention access
distributional gap in eligible households beyond timely prevention access
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not call a candidate site trusted, low-barrier, accessible, or effective without user evidence.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for low-barrier housing-stability service hubs passes documented checks for parcel control, legal authority, environmental review, access, capacity, and operator responsibility.

title: Site low-barrier housing-stability access hubs
